**First public beta of Lindale**, a Windows desktop port of [Metrolist](https://github.com/MetrolistGroup/Metrolist) 13.7.0.

### Install
1. Download **Lindale-setup.exe** below and run it.
2. Windows SmartScreen may show *"Windows protected your PC"* because the installer is not code-signed yet. Click **More info → Run anyway**.

Prefer no installer? Download **Lindale-portable.zip**, extract it anywhere and run `Lindale.exe`.

Requirements: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit.

### Highlights
- Desktop interface with a single Spotify-style title bar
- Sign in with Google, or with a browser cookie
- Lyrics source picker that checks every provider, and tap-to-sync for out-of-time lyrics
- Offline downloads, persistent queue, remembered window size and position
- Equalizer, tempo and pitch, loudness normalization, Discord Rich Presence
- "Hide clean duplicates" setting, 50+ languages

### Known limitations
- Beta: please [report bugs](https://github.com/supdocquart/Lindale/issues).
- The in-app update check is off in this version; watch this repo's releases for updates.
